title: Alpha-value parameter for transparent renderers
abstract:
Would this be reasonably easy to implement via the shaders, simply giving all a renderer's triangles an alpha value?

It would be useful for all renderers, but especially transparent isosurfaces would be a very cool feature, see for example [this](https://blog.kitware.com/gpu-rendering-of-isosurfaces/):
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/20167491/40717295-13b1e942-640c-11e8-8ce4-172d02e83569.png)
